summary: A thin divider line used to group related items inside a panel's menu.
description:
A plain <hr>, author-supplied light-DOM content placed inside <panel-list> by consumers.

**panel-list.mjs never creates a separator itself:** it renders only a default <slot>.

**Styled purely by a slotted rule:** matched via `::slotted(hr:not([hidden]))` in panel-list.css, using --panel-separator-color/--panel-separator-padding tokens, with no dedicated class or tagName of its own.
